github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Follow Conventional Commits (Angular): <type>(scope?): short subject. Examples: "feat(orchestrator): add user language preference", "fix(discord): handle empty attachments".
Main types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert. Start the message with the appropriate type.
The scope is optional and names the affected part of the project (e.g. "orchestrator", "discord", "agent").
Keep the subject concise, preferably <= 50 characters, without a trailing period. Use the body for additional context when needed.
Focus on meaningful changes and avoid generic messages such as "update code" or "improve maintainability".
Ignore generated or metadata files such as package-lock.json unless the change is relevant.
Write a single subject line and, when needed, a detailed body after it, separated by a blank line.
